//: The controller lookup on compatibility.html, inlined into the page at build time; nothing is fetched at runtime. Copied, not read from ../steer: the deploy build has no checkout of the app. tested = run on real hardware (DualSense: Sean's own; Xbox Series X|S: 'verified' in steer/Steer/Sources/Steer/Resources/controller-devices.txt, and docs/lessons/xbox-haptics-are-bluetooth-only.md). expected = a family Steer reads through Apple's GameController framework, never run here on hardware. untested = outside those families, so it rides the SDL generic-pad bridge, which has never run on a physical pad (steer/CLAUDE.md). Each note says what Steer cannot do on it and must agree with the matrix on the same page. Xbox names follow controller-names.txt.

controllers.name: DualSense
controllers.note: Everything on this page works, including the triggers that push back. It has no rear paddles.

controllers.name: Xbox Wireless Controller (Series X|S)
controllers.note: Rumble works over Bluetooth only, not over USB. No triggers that push back, no light Steer can set, no touchpad, no tilt to aim.

controllers.name: DualSense Edge
controllers.note: Everything a DualSense does. The back buttons are untested, and the PS button over Bluetooth is off by default.

controllers.name: DualShock 4
controllers.note: No triggers that push back and no mute light. Tilt to aim is off by default and in beta, because macOS reports no motion for it.

controllers.name: Xbox One S Controller
controllers.note: No triggers that push back, no light Steer can set, no touchpad, no tilt to aim.

controllers.name: Xbox One Controller
controllers.note: No triggers that push back, no light Steer can set, no touchpad, no tilt to aim.

controllers.name: Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2
controllers.note: The rear paddles are in beta: built, not yet confirmed on hardware. No triggers that push back, no light Steer can set, no touchpad, no tilt to aim.

controllers.name: Xbox Elite Wireless Controller
controllers.note: The rear paddles are in beta: built, not yet confirmed on hardware. No triggers that push back, no light Steer can set, no touchpad, no tilt to aim.

controllers.name: Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
controllers.note: Rumble is a simplified version of the real effect. No triggers that push back, no light bar, no touchpad. The player lights are off by default and untested.

controllers.name: Joy-Con (one on its own)
controllers.note: Connects as buttons and battery only, plus tilt if macOS reports motion. No stick, so no cursor. Unfinished.

controllers.name: Other Made-for-iPhone (MFi) controller
controllers.note: The cursor, scroll, typing and shortcuts, plus battery. Rumble only if the pad reports it. No tilt to aim, light bar, touchpad or triggers that push back: those need each brand's own protocol.

controllers.name: 8BitDo controller
controllers.note: If macOS shows it as an Xbox, Switch or MFi pad, that row applies. Otherwise it goes through Steer's off-brand path, which has never run on a real pad.

controllers.name: Xbox 360 Controller
controllers.note: Not a family macOS supports on its own, so it goes through Steer's off-brand path, which has never run on a real pad.

controllers.name: Logitech gamepad
controllers.note: Goes through Steer's off-brand path, which has never run on a real pad.

controllers.name: Stadia Controller
controllers.note: Goes through Steer's off-brand path, which has never run on a real pad.

controllers.name: Steam Controller
controllers.note: Goes through Steer's off-brand path, which has never run on a real pad.
